```{r}
jud2 <- readr::read_delim("data/judgments.tsv",
             col_types = 
               cols(start_date = col_date(format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
                    end_date = col_date(format =  "%d/%m/%Y"),
                    finished = "f",
                    condition = "f",
                    gender = "f",
                    logbook = "c", 
                    exclude = "f",
                    moral_judgment = "d",
                    moral_judgment_disgust = "d",
                    moral_judgment_non_disgust = "d",
                    .default = col_integer()))
jud2
```
